searches.reason: Develop an inference-aligned diagnostic suite to explain why healthy masked-training margins coexist with weaker next-item ranking. Use frozen training-history prefixes, excluded targets, appended MASK and the maximum nonpadding readout. Compare recent-item deletion, count-matched random deletion, and order changes with identical candidates; report paired ranking changes, user-clustered uncertainty and identity controls. Seek methods that distinguish useful context dependence from sensitivity alone, without changing the pinned evaluator or fitting additional predictors.
searches.query: BERT4Rec sequential recommendation diagnostic benchmarks 2024 2025 2026 masked reconstruction next-item ranking mismatch history perturbation recency order sensitivity negative sampling bias

searches.reason: Move from embedding geometry to measurements that connect failures to specific training signals and network components. Investigate repeated, bounded gradient measurements for reconstruction and terminal objectives, separating embedding and encoder effects under the actual loss denominators and coefficients. Require checkpoint-bound sampler provenance and consistency checks: supplied snapshots and definitions disagree about allocation. Seek estimators and controls that distinguish gradient conflict, estimator variance and target-count normalization effects without assuming that 75% terminal examples means 75% gradient weight. All probes inspect the single trained BERT4Rec model per category.
searches.query: multi-task learning gradient diagnostics 2024 2025 2026 gradient conflict covariance layerwise attribution variable token loss normalization masked language modeling auxiliary objective provenance

searches.reason: Build a feedback-grounded failure taxonomy that distinguishes “choose now,” broad relatedness, explicit rejection and insufficient evidence. Seek validated annotation methods using supplied titles, descriptions, timestamps and explicit feedback, with evidence spans, abstention, annotation agreement and coverage reporting. Apply this to the twenty training-user full-catalog recommendation audits. Compatibility, duplication, quantity and mood should be recorded only when supported; histories cannot establish ownership or unresolved demand. This would capture practical failures absent from margin and geometry probes while keeping unavailable attributes and simulator traits unknown.
